title: Use personal GitHub identity for fantasy repository pushes
description:
## Context

The required push of the Full planning setup failed: git push -u origin master reported permission denied to DDC-Heartwood for DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git. This blocks publishing the planning state tracked by fantasy-p55, the epic for the initial product planning session.

## Steps to Reproduce

In /home/ddc/dev-environment/fantasy, origin in .git/config is git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git. Run git push -u origin master using the current github.com SSH host configuration.

## Expected Behavior

The operator-authorized personal repository accepts the planning commits using the configured personal identity.

## Actual Behavior

The github.com host in /home/ddc/.ssh/config selects ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 and authenticates as DDC-Heartwood, which lacks write access. Read-only gh auth status confirms an existing active DylanDelliColli account. The same SSH configuration defines github-personal with ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_personal.

## Approach

Use the existing github-personal SSH host for this repository's push URL, preserving the operator-supplied origin fetch URL and global account configuration. Push the committed planning state and verify remote tracking. If the personal SSH identity fails, use the existing personal GitHub CLI credential through HTTPS without printing credential values.

## File footprint

.git/config (local push URL only), .beads/issues.jsonl (tracked work state). Do not modify /home/ddc/.ssh/config or private keys.

## Test Spec

[no-test] Credential routing and tracker metadata only; no application code path. Verify with a real git push -u origin master, git status -sb reporting origin/master without ahead commits, and git ls-remote confirming the published commit. Run br lint --status all.

## Acceptance Criteria

The planning commits are pushed to DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant, the local branch tracks origin/master, and a normal repository-local push uses the authorized personal identity. Record validation and close this blocker.
close_reason: Resolved and verified: repository pushes use the existing personal SSH identity; planning commits published successfully.

[no-test]: local credential configuration only; actual remote write verified.

title: Plan a personal Sleeper fantasy football assistant
description:
## Context

The operator requested a full /abacus-plan session for /home/ddc/dev-environment/fantasy and explicitly confirmed Full on 2026-09-08. The repository has no application code. The operator supplied git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git as its remote; origin is configured and planning state is committed and published on origin/master. Pushes use the existing github-personal SSH host.

## Scope

Follow /home/ddc/.claude/skills/abacus-plan/SKILL.md to define the product and first useful release, then produce an approved execution-ready backlog. Full is warranted because product scope, domain assumptions, interfaces, and architecture remain unknown. The current substage is FRAMING. The operator confirmed personal fantasy football draft planning and in-season team management using Sleeper. First-release scope and architecture remain undecided.

Maintain the single in-flight record PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md, registered by docs-corpus.json under inflight_globs. Append each Full substage and commit each gate deliverable. Obtain operator approval of FRAMING, RESEARCH, ARCHITECTURE, TEST-STRATEGY, RECORD, and DECOMPOSITION before advancing. Use docs/adr/ for durable architecture decisions when warranted. Delete the in-flight record at approved execution handoff after preserving its substance in beads and any durable decision records.

## Confirmed Intent and Open Questions

US-DRAFT-01: Help the operator plan their fantasy football draft. US-SEASON-01: Help the operator manage their fantasy football team throughout the season. Sleeper is the confirmed platform. These stable story identifiers and framing proposals are in PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md.

Q1 resolved: Personal fantasy football draft planning and in-season team management using Sleeper.
Q2 resolved: The remote is git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git; planning state is pushed.
Q3 open: Which league (ID/URL if available), redraft/keeper/dynasty format, and is the next draft ahead?
Q4 open: Draft assistance, season management, or both for the first useful release; which specific decisions matter most?
Q5 open: Recommendations for the operator to execute, or also execution after explicit approval if platform capabilities permit?

Non-goals, the precise epic product success metric, the narrowest useful release, and prerequisites await the framing answers and approval. Prerequisites are unassessed, not confirmed absent. Implementation paths and symbols must be determined during approved planning.

## File footprint

.beads/issues.jsonl, docs-corpus.json, PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md. Later planning may create warranted records under docs/adr/; their exact paths and scope must be recorded before authoring.

## Test Spec

[no-test] This epic currently changes planning documents and tracker/corpus metadata only, with no application code path. Validate the corpus JSON and in-flight registration, inspect git diff, and run br lint --status all. Each eventual code child must specify unit and real-composition integration tests, concrete inputs and assertions, verification commands, and its full file footprint. Measure any existing full suite during TEST-STRATEGY and estimate proposed additions against the 30-second full-suite budget.

## Success Criteria

The operator has approved the tier and all required stage gates. The resulting children pass the Fresh Agent Test, include requirements-directed dependencies and unit/integration test contracts, and have zero unresolved questions. Check br dep tree, br ready, and br lint before handoff. Planning and tracker state are committed and pushed to the confirmed remote. Execution is not launched as part of planning.
